snippets.name: curl pandoc html to markdown
snippets.body: export URL="${URL:-CHANGE URL}" MDOUTPUT="${HOME}/Desktop/saved.md" ; curl -fsSL "${URL}" | pandoc -f html -t gfm-raw_html-fenced_divs --wrap=none -o "${MDOUTPUT}"
snippets.description: Use curl and pandoc to open HTML pages and try to save it as markdown.

snippets.name: Restart WireGuard All Hosts
snippets.body: ssh -t m132 'zsh -lc ". ~/.zshrc ; sudo wg-quick down wg0 ; sudo wg-quick up wg0 ;"' ; ssh -t m4128 'zsh -lc ". ~/.zshrc ; sudo wg-quick down wg0 ; sudo wg-quick up wg0 ;"' ; ssh -t fedoraair 'zsh -lc ". ~/.zshrc ; sudo wg-quick down wg0 ; sudo wg-quick up wg0 ;"'
snippets.description: Use ssh to restart WireGuard in all local hosts.

snippets.name: Clear Docker History, Volumes and Networks
snippets.body: docker stop `docker ps -q -a` ; docker builder prune -f ; docker system prune -f ; docker volume prune -f ; docker builder prune -f ; docker network prune -f ; docker builder history rm --all ; docker builder prune -f ;

snippets.name: Create TTS for daily briefings
snippets.body: bq --label daily_breafing_tts_clean --json --concurrency-key audio-playback zsh -lc '. ~/.zshrc ; llm_clean --model "${LOCAL_MODEL}" -c "$(cat ~/omnews_briefings/"$(date +%Y-%m-%d)".md)" -- --nowordwrap --think=max --hidethinking > ~/omnews_briefings/"$(date +%Y-%m-%d)"_tts.txt ; msg="Daily Paper Markdown Cleaner Finished." osalert'
snippets.description: Create a TTS file for the current date on omnews briefing.

snippets.name: OMQueue Test Local (AUDIO)
snippets.body: bq --label omqueue_test_snippet --json --cwd "$(pwd)" --concurrency-key audio-playback zsh -lc '. ~/.zshrc ; edgetts <<< "Attention. This is only a test of the O M Queue distributed emergency audio system. The end."'
snippets.description: Queue the OMQueue audio test locally. If you can hear the audio, it is working.

snippets.name: OMQueue Test Local (TEXT)
snippets.body: bq --label omqueue-test-text --cwd "${HOME}/Desktop" --json --concurrency-key one-shot bash -c 'for i in {1..5}; do echo -n "Linha: ${i}"; sleep 0.5; done' | jq -r .jobId | xargs -I {} omqueue_follow --json {} | jq -r .output.payload.text
snippets.description: Queue the OMQueue text only test locally. If you can see the text, it is working.

snippets.body: for t in codex codex-ollama agy pi; do sannux setup "$t"; sannux rebuild "$t"; done
